title: Kevin J.S. Duska Jr., chat statement to the Demko agent, 11 Nov 2026
extract: Descent given as: Kevin J.S. Duska Jr. → Kevin John Duska → Stefan Duska → Mihaly Duska and Maria Demko. Maria Demko described as the wife of his father's father's father.
reliability: Family knowledge plus Kevin's own earlier research. No document seen. Names above the father are second-hand at best.

title: Baptism register entry no. 36 of 1882: Mihály, son of György Demkó and Mária Hreskó, Viszoka 132
extract: Born 19 Aug 1882, baptised 20 Aug 1882. Father Greek Catholic farmer, mother Roman Catholic. Godparents Mihály Varga and Anna Hreskó, both Roman Catholic.
reliability: Original record made the day after the birth: strong for the event and the parents. Weak for provenance: parish, denomination and archive reference rest on the file name alone.

type: Authored report (research pass, compiled by a research agent from web sources)
title: Research pass 1 on the Demko surname in Ung county, 12 Nov 2026
extract: Identifies the Greek Catholic priest of Čičarovce in 1882-1886 as Ján Csurgovics and the Roman Catholic priest in 1868-1890 as Andrej (Endre) Polányi; places Vysoká nad Uhom as a Greek Catholic filial of Čičarovce from after 1806 to 1948; gives film numbers for the Čičarovce registers; quotes Act LIII of 1868, section 12; finds no Demko in a private transcription of the 1715 lists for the four villages; finds nothing in North American indexes.
reliability: Secondary throughout: municipal and parish web pages, reference works, a private transcription, catalogue numbers relayed by a finding list. Good for where to look, not for who anyone was. Two statements in it came from the owner's private correspondence and are set aside (DM-DEC-010). The report text is not archived here for that reason; the findings used are in leads DM-L-014 to DM-L-021.
